name: BrowserGym
summary: ServiceNow's Gym environment for web agents that bundles MiniWoB, WebArena, VisualWebArena, WorkArena, AssistantBench and more behind one API.
description: Install with `pip install browsergym` (or per-benchmark packages such as `browsergym-webarena`, `browsergym-workarena`). New web benchmarks subclass `AbstractBrowserTask`. Companion framework AgentLab runs and evaluates agents across all BrowserGym benchmarks. The README notes it is a research framework, not a consumer product. PyPI `browsergym` 0.14.3 (2026-01-20).
